items.title: Warren Buffett will go down as the 'greatest investor of all time'
items.summary: Warren Buffett stepped down as the chairman of Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-A, BRK-B) last week, to be succeeded by his son Howard. The Glenview Trust Company CIO Bill Stone discusses Buffett's legacy as an investor before talking about Berkshire's latest stock price moves.

items.title: Meta stock jumps as Wells Fargo raises price target
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Tech Editor Dan Howley joins Market Domination to discuss Meta (META) more than 10% intraday surge after Wells Fargo (WFC) raised its price target on the stock from $640 to $796. Meta also got a boost from its Meta Muse AI agent app climbing to the top spot on Apple's (AAPL) App Store, highlighting growing momentum around the company's AI push.

items.title: Warren Buffett Just Stepped Down. These 2 AI Stocks Still Define Berkshire’s Portfolio
items.summary: Warren Buffett formally stepped down as Berkshire Hathaway’s chairman on September 18, ending more than five decades in the job and handing the nonexecutive chairmanship to his son Howard Buffett. Greg Abel already runs Berkshire as CEO, while Buffett remains a director and chairman emeritus. The succession makes Berkshire’s equity portfolio more interesting than usual. […]

items.title: Google Backs Nuclear Expansion at Georgia Power Plants
items.summary: Google will support nuclear plant upgrades in Georgia that could add 96 MW of capacity and deliver projected customer savings.

items.title: Apple (AAPL) Eyes India Payments With Apple Pay Debut Next Month
items.summary: Apple (NasdaqGS:AAPL) plans to launch Apple Pay in India next month, starting with Axis Bank as an initial partner. The company is in discussions with additional Indian lenders to extend Apple Pay support beyond the initial Axis Bank rollout. Apple and Google are recruiting senior crypto and blockchain specialists to work on stablecoins, tokenized deposits and related digital asset infrastructure. items.title: Google Fined By Irish Privacy Regulator For Location Data
items.summary: The Alphabet company has been ordered to align its data-processing practices with GDPR within six months.

items.title: Google, Georgia Power Have Deal to Support Nuclear Power Plant Uprates
items.summary: Electric utility Georgia Power and tech giant Google said the companies have an agreement under which Google will support power uprates at two of the utility's nuclear power plants.
